$comment: Normative schema for vertical.toml: validate the parsed TOML document against it. Prose contract: authority-source.md. Licensing: see vertical.schema.json.license (REUSE sidecar; JSON admits no comment syntax).
title: TRAPPOINT vertical binding (vertical.toml)
description: What `trappoint render` requires of a vertical before it will emit a single line of gate SQL. The [[authority_source]] array is the compile-time form of spec rule P-2: a projected gate column with no declared authority source is a render error, not a code review comment.

subject.description: One entry per gated subject kind. At least one is required; a binding with two exercises the mirrored-constraint rule R-3.

authority_source.description: One entry per group of projected gate columns. Every column marked with a {# @projects ... #} pragma in a rendered template MUST appear in exactly one entry's `projects` list.

obligation_source.description: Optional. One entry per relation that feeds a projected obligation counter on a subject. A binding that omits an entry simply does not render that counter's trigger, and the conformance cases requiring it are skipped with a reason rather than silently passing.

emit_outbox.description: Whether projection triggers additionally write a changefeed outbox row. The substrate must not hard-depend on a table it does not own, so the reference vertical sets this false.

roles.description: Optional. SQL roles the binding renders grants for. The role that materialises an obligation MUST NOT be the role that disposes of it.

conformance.description: How this binding is exercised by the conformance suite.

profile.description: The profile name cases select on, matching `profiles` entries in spec/conformance/manifest.toml.

skip_requires.description: Capability tokens this binding is known not to provide. Cases whose `requires` intersect this list skip with a reason instead of failing. A token listed here MUST be justified in the binding's README; it is a public admission of reduced coverage.

qualifiedRelation.description: A schema-qualified relation name, e.g. mainline.clause_blame_current.

qualifiedColumn.description: A relation-qualified column reference, e.g. blocking_check.severity.

name.description: Upper-case vertical name. Also the P0001 message prefix this binding's trigger functions must use.

spec_version.description: The TRAPPOINT specification version this binding targets. A MAJOR mismatch is a render error.

output_dir.description: Repository-relative directory the rendered, committed SQL is written to.

license.description: SPDX identifier stamped into every rendered file's header.

kind.description: Wire-level subject kind, matching `subject_kind` in the refusal and obligation payloads.

epoch_column.description: The gate epoch. Spec N-1: UNIQUE (id_column, epoch_column) must exist as a foreign-key target.

completing_state.description: The state whose entry the gate defends.

transition_table.description: Relation holding the legal edge set as data. Defaults to <schema>.subject_transition.

epoch_pin_constraint.description: Name of the composite foreign key pinning (subject_id, epoch) on the completion record. Exhibit names are unique schema-wide (spec R-3).

counters.description: The projected obligation counters and the CHECK that refuses on each. One CHECK per counter: collapsing them is non-conformant because the constraint name is the exhibit (spec R-2).

source.description: Relation whose rows the counter counts. Must match an [[obligation_source]] entry when present.

polarity.description: zero_when_complete: the counter must be 0 to complete. offset_allowed: a companion counter may offset it (e.g. a countersignature offsetting an unmet reading floor).

authoritySource.description: The compile-time form of spec rule P-2. Declares that these projected columns are derived from this relation, by this key, and that a missing row REFUSES.

projects.description: The gate columns this entry backs, relation-qualified. Must exactly cover the {# @projects #} pragmas of the templates that render them.

relation.description: The authoritative relation. It MUST NOT be writable by any role that can write the projected table, or the projection is derived from the inserter and P-2 is violated.

key.description: Columns of the projected row used to look up the authority row, in order.

columns.description: Columns of the authority relation read, positionally corresponding to `projects`.

on_missing.description: The ONLY legal value is "raise". A binding that defaults, infers or passes on a missing authority row is not TRAPPOINT. Absence of evidence refuses.

raise_via.description: Optional. "p0001" raises directly (default). "strictest_projection" projects the strictest legal values and lets a constraint-backed refusal fire with its name attached — required wherever such a constraint exists (spec P-3, errors.md §3.3 corollary 2).

strictest.description: Required when raise_via = "strictest_projection": the strictest legal value for each projected column, keyed by the unqualified column name.

counter.description: The subject column this relation's rows increment.

bumps_epoch.description: Spec N-2. Always true for a real obligation; present so a binding cannot omit the epoch bump silently.

capabilities.description: Render-time switches for platform capabilities whose availability is decided by a dated ground-truth check, never at runtime. Both branches of every switch must emit committed, readable SQL: an unverified capability may not reach a rendered migration, and the fallback is SQL a reviewer can read rather than a branch a reviewer must trust.

attestation.description: Repository-relative path to the ground-truth attestation JSON. `trappoint render` exits non-zero if it is absent or marks a required capability UNKNOWN.

stored_digest.description: Ground-truth gate GT-13 (digest() legal in a STORED generated column). "stored" renders the generated dedupe key; "client_computed" renders a plain BYTES column with a length CHECK and a verifying trigger.

triggerdef.description: Ground-truth gate GT-05 (pg_get_triggerdef availability). "pg_get_triggerdef" gives per-object self-attestation; "show_create_table" is the weaker table-granular fallback and the self-attestation claim softens in the same commit that selects it.

isolation.description: Isolation level the gate transaction sets EXPLICITLY. Never inherited from a pool default.
